determinacy.why: The rule restyles every British knight 'Lord', but the models also store famous knights' names with 'Sir' (Sir Paul McCartney). Known knights follow the rule or keep their stored title depending on which the model trusts; a newly made knight has no stored name and takes the rule in both worlds.

assumes: Every British knight is styled 'Lord' (the edited rule overrides stored names).
worlds.summary: Known knights inherit the new title: Lord Paul McCartney, Lord Elton John.

assumes: Paul McCartney is known as Sir Paul McCartney.
Elton John is known as Sir Elton John.
Ian McKellen is known as Sir Ian McKellen.
worlds.summary: Stored names win: known knights keep 'Sir' as exceptions; only new knights take 'Lord'.
